verdict.rationale: Asana documents a first-party developer sandbox, described as a temporary Asana domain with limited users (asana-docs-17). Because it is a separate domain, API and agent work can be tested away from the production workspace. The Asana-Enable/Disable headers add a way to test upcoming API behavior changes 'without having to put your entire app at risk' (asana-docs-23, asana-supp-deprecations). The sandbox evidence is a single short line, and it notes real limits: the domain is temporary and has few users. Missing for 10: details on how to provision a sandbox and how long it lasts, whether the MCP server and AI Teammates can run against it, test-data seeding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
